name: osm
description: Replaces a secret with a format-preserving fake before the model reads it, and restores the real credential on the way into a tool call. The map survives a resume or a reload; set persist off to keep it in memory only.

entropy.title: Entropy layer
entropy.description: Mask high-entropy tokens that no pattern matches. Catches vendors with no rule, and can mask a random-looking URL path.

entropyThreshold.title: Entropy threshold
entropyThreshold.description: Bits per character above which a string counts as random.

entropyMinLen.title: Entropy minimum length
entropyMinLen.description: Shortest string the entropy layer will consider.

envFiles.title: Env files
envFiles.description: Files read at session start for the exact-match layer, relative to the session's directory.

persist.title: Persist the map
persist.description: Carry the fake-to-secret map across a resume, a fork or a reload. Writes a plaintext file under the Claude Code configuration directory.

retentionDays.title: Retention days
retentionDays.description: How long a stored literal secret survives. Env-backed entries store no secret and never expire.
